Issue #2229: terminal `git commit` while OpenChamber reads Git status.

Lab: a repository with 80,000 tracked files, macOS, git 2.50.1 (Apple Git-155).
A scratch OpenChamber server (`bun server/index.js`) runs from main 74b79d41e or
from the fix branch. While a loop requests GET /api/git/status for the repository,
a terminal loop appends a line to one file, runs `git add` and `git commit`, and
counts the commits that fail.

Modes:
- loop:  status requests back to back
- poll:  one status request every 2 seconds
- stale: back to back, and before every commit 2,000 files get a new timestamp
         with unchanged content, as a formatter or build tool leaves them

main 74b79d41e
[main-loop]   status requests=49 failed commits=57/200
[main-poll2s] status requests=18 failed commits=19/300
[main-stale]  status requests=70 failed commits=61/200
first error: fatal: Unable to create '<repo>/.git/index.lock': File exists.

main + GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 only, working stats still from `git diff --numstat`
[flag-only-stale] status requests=78 failed commits=26/200
first error: fatal: Unable to create '<repo>/.git/index.lock': File exists.

fix branch
[branch-loop]   status requests=64 failed commits=0/200
[branch-poll2s] status requests=24 failed commits=0/300
[branch-stale]  status requests=86 failed commits=0/200

Plain git, same repository, a reader in a tight loop next to 100 add+commit runs:
reader=status GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=1 failed=71/100
reader=status GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 failed=0/100

Whether a read rewrites a stale index (one file with an older timestamp):
status --porcelain       GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=1: index REWRITTEN
status --porcelain       GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0: index unchanged
diff --numstat           GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=1: index REWRITTEN
diff --numstat           GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0: index REWRITTEN
diff --cached --numstat  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=1: index unchanged
diff --cached --numstat  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0: index unchanged
diff-files -M --numstat  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0: index unchanged

A deleted tracked file plus an intent-to-add copy with one added line:
status:                    R a.txt -> b.txt
diff --numstat:          1  0  a.txt => b.txt
diff-files --numstat:    0  8  a.txt / 9  0  b.txt
diff-files -M --numstat: 1  0  a.txt => b.txt   (same as `git diff`)

Working diff stats, fix branch server vs `git diff --numstat` on a dirty tree
(appended lines, a partially staged file, a deleted file, a binary change):
git diff --numstat          server diffStats.working
2  0  src/d5/f1.txt         2  0  src/d5/f1.txt
1  0  src/d5/f2.txt         1  0  src/d5/f2.txt
0  1  src/d5/f3.txt         0  1  src/d5/f3.txt
-  -  src/d5/f4.txt         0  0  src/d5/f4.txt   (binary; main also stores 0/0)
